text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: Alright, the rook moves—to the far right, there.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: New Year's Day of the Senior Class. After returning from our Hatsumode shrine visit, the two of us play chess.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: Heh... Talk about déjà vu.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Ah, weren't we hanging out
like this before the Arima Kinen, too?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Our conversations were always held over board games.
Before I knew it, that had become second nature.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: Still, the Senior year, huh? A whole lot happened to bring us all the way here, Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: Right after enrolling, she suffered one narrow defeat after another. Unable to complain to anyone, she fought on alone...

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
"I'm never gonna run with you guys
ever againnn! Idiots, idiots!"

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: "However, once you came and pleaded, 'Please let me be your trainer,' everything began to turn around for the better."

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
"Because you're the nicest! You don't get mad,
and you play board games with me! You have to be my Trainer!!
Otherwise, I'm quitting everything!!"

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Pisa, Rose, Flash-san...
Rather than facing such strong-willed rivals
with sheer willpower—

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
By strictly confronting it through "strategy,"
we've become able to face each other on equal footing.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: This is... an unvarnished, completely honest replay of my racing history.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: Nn... Did I remember something wrong?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I feel like what was asked of me was the exact opposite...
Well, let's not sweat the small details.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Anyway, just one more step.
Just one more step until I become ruler.
If only I can bridge that final gap—

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: —Checkmate.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: The world—shall belong to me.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: Now, about those "final touches"...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —From the rooftop, we talked while looking down at the track.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
"Do you really think that simply racking up achievements
in the Twinkle Series like this
will earn you the throne of a ruler?"

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Take the world of board games, for instance.
There comes a moment when a star player's name
spreads in the blink of an eye. Indeed—

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: —The national championship, or perhaps the world stage. Through legendary plays made there—

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: Someone who had been merely a single player was transforming into a charismatic icon.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
I was thinking that maybe
we need that kind of breakthrough.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
A symbolic event to clearly demonstrate
that this Rulership is indeed the sovereign.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Even if she wins GⅠs sporadically, she might not be seen as an absolute ruler. To make everyone acknowledge her...

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: Trainer... don't you feel eyes on us?

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
—From behind the door.
Someone is watching us from over there.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Told to look, I definitely... felt a presence.
Someone is behind the door.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Who is it? Stalking us like this.
Trainer, who do you think it is?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I try to picture it. A shadow gazing at Rulership.
A likely possibility is...

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
An industrial spy, huh... Come to think of it,
there used to be a board game featuring corporate espionage.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
An agent sent to steal our strategy, huh?
In that case—

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: *Yaaawn*... Nice weather today, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
From this point on, we're having a completely meaningless conversation.
Got it?

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Diced steak, right...
I wonder if they have ones shaped like 100-sided dice.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After chatting about trivial nonsense like that, we casually
let the industrial spy pass us by.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
An unrequited love...
For me? Or... for you?

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Wait, what, you're that kind of person!?
I had no idea! I totally didn't know about this!?

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
I-I see. So you were captivated
by my running in the race, were you?

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
I don't know who they are, but...
well, it doesn't feel bad. Hehehe...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even with a target on his back,
Rulership was beaming with confidence.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
A shadow... master? Are you saying
there's a mastermind pulling our strings behind the scenes?

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, well that would be interesting.
Alright, in that case—

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: Why don't we settle which of us is the true master of the game? Just so you know, though—

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Don't underestimate the depth of my repertoire.
I have countless ways to defeat you.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Rulership indulged in letting
her imagination run wild.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: A little while after that—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (*tap-tap-tap-tap...*)

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Hm, they fled, did they?
...Very well.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: In the end, who was that person anyway, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
We never found out their true identity.
Still, I'll keep watch just to make sure Rulership doesn't come to any harm.
